org_similarity_list.target_short_description: Status.im is a mobile ethereum OS that gives users the power to chat, transact, and access a world of DApps on the decentralized web.
Kresus is an open-source, privacy-focused personal finance manager built on Web3 technologies.
Telegram is a cloud-based messaging platform focused on speed, security, privacy, and cross-device synchronization.
Coinbase is a crypto exchange and wallet platform that allows merchants and consumers to buy, sell, and store digital currencies.
Venmo offers an app that allows users to share and make payments with friends for a variety of services.
Farcaster is a social network that helps coders, fitness enthusiasts, and meme makers find people based on their interests.
Lens Protocol is a composable and decentralized social network serving the Web3 community.
Zerion is an all-in-one interface that allows technical and non-technical users to acquire, track and manage DeFi assets.
Rainbow is a mobile app of Ethereum wallet for managing your assets.
Phantom is a crypto wallet that facilitates the buying, trading, and storing of cryptocurrencies, including NFTs and tokens.
MetaMask is a crypto wallet that allows users to manage their digital assets through a browser extension or mobile app.
